headline: Oil continues to rise toward its biggest weekly gain since mid-July
summary: Oil prices rose on Friday and were on track for their biggest weekly gain since mid-July. Escalating tensions and renewed fighting between the United States and Iran fueled supply concerns.
why: Brent is the global benchmark for crude oil, and Middle East supply risks are a major driver of its price.
why_moved: Renewed US-Iran fighting and escalating tensions raised concerns about Middle East oil supply.
